message:
Plain words: the chassis still stows like a suitcase then widens for stable work, with finger gaps so wheels never rub frame or digger. Stowed size is 0.900 m by 0.420 m by 0.450 m inside the 1.00 m by 0.500 m by 0.500 m box, deploying to 1.05 m long by 0.680 m track with 0.110 m wheel radius and 0.025 m rotation gap from the tip dump clearance deployed vs stowed and pressure check (E51), and ground pressure is 15.6 kPa from the ground pressure four wheels estimate (E25); everyday scale says softer than a standing person at about 30 kPa, so sinkage stays shallow on loose simulant, Power Structure and Integration Lead please keep the twin-tube rails inside that stowed width.

Plain words: the wheels pull far harder than the narrow slot needs and the raised pour stays upright only when kept light and level. Traction is 294 N from the stowed envelope sum, ground pressure, tip-over and stopping check (E23) against kerf cut 11.0 N from the scale cut force to 100 mm kerf (E64), about 1 kg push against a person-scale machine, and raised-pour factor is 1.69 level-only at 15.0 kg trips with 0.550 m pivot clearing the 0.400 m lip by 0.150 m from the tip dump clearance deployed vs stowed and pressure check (E51); stop is 0.0625 m brake-only from the stowed envelope sum, ground pressure, tip-over and stopping check (E23) versus 0.308 m with 0.500 s link loss from the link-loss watchdog stop distance vs latency simulation (E32), a shoe length, so Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead please keep 15.0 kg level-only dumps and Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead please keep speed capped.

Plain words: Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead docking accuracy sets what my skid steering must actually achieve at the bin. I take from the Advanced Edge Detection of AprilTags for Precise Docking Maneuvers of Mobile Robots (E54) the finding that tag-guided docking reaches about 4.5 cm deviation, which from chassis view means creep positioning to 0.030 m to 0.040 m at 1.00 m to 2.00 m from the fiducial final-align error budget and stall current backout timing (E58) is within skid-steer creep capability if final trim is done at 0.100 m per s, and I take from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) the precedent that a 120 lb, meaning about 54.4 kg, winner sits at the same person-scale mass as our 46.0 kg from the updated mass sum (E62), so our wheel load and pressure regime is proven buildable. Ready, because envelope, float, traction, clearance and tip all survive my strongest chassis objections with only arching, wear and tag-visibility bench tests left.
